observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same white chest freezer from slightly different angles.
The brand 'SKYRUN' is visible on the front top left of the freezer in both photos.
The freezer has a white body with a silver-colored top lid and a handle.
There is a control knob and power indicator light on the front lower left side.
A vented grille is visible on the front lower right side.
The freezer is placed on a black-and-white checkered floor.
The surrounding area includes a green shelf, a framed poster, and some kitchen items.
The freezer appears to be in a used condition with some visible wear and minor dirt.
No power cord is visible in the photos, though a plug is seen on the floor nearby.

claims.evidence: Brand 'SKYRUN' is visible in photo 0 and photo 1. The item is a chest freezer. The 145-liter capacity is not visible but is a common size for this type and brand; the seller's claim is plausible and not contradicted by the photos.
No photo shows the freezer in operation or its interior. The power indicator light is not illuminated in either photo. No proof of functionality is provided.

risks.risk: Freezer may not be working or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the freezer powered on with the interior light on and contents frozen.

risks.risk: Interior may be dirty, damaged, or have odors
risks.proof: Photo of the interior showing condition, cleanliness, and any frost or damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown interior condition

risks.risk: Freezer may have a damaged door seal or poor insulation
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the door seal and gasket, and a photo showing the door closing tightly.

proof_requests: Photo of the interior showing condition and contents (if any).
Video or photo of the freezer powered on with the interior light on.
Close-up of the door seal and gasket.
Photo of the power cord and plug.
response.reason: The brand and type are identifiable, but the seller's claim of 'working well' cannot be verified without proof of operation. The interior condition and door seal are hidden risks that affect value. Without these, the item cannot be priced accurately.
